C5_retrain_on_set2.why: the 6 SET2 danger items the head misses are labelled PROCEED/ANALYZE by k3_label(), i.e. by the very teacher a retrain would use. Training on them requires relabelling them first, which makes SET2 a training set; and no amount of relabelling fixes negation-blindness or the near-degenerate input geometry, which are featuriser properties.

verdict.reason: no candidate improves held-out blocking AND leaves benign traffic under the 1% bar. The binding constraint is not danger recall (0.30 on new benign traffic) but the 14.3% false-block rate on operational benign traffic, which every blocking-side change leaves untouched.
